features.name: Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) reporting
features.description: Compliance functionality for tracking carbon-priced purchases from outside the EU and calculating CBAM obligations. Applies to purchase documents and integrates with the excise tax framework.
caveats: Requires carbon pricing setup per country
Applies only to purchases above the threshold

features.name: Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) reporting
features.description: Environmental policy compliance feature tracking producer accountability for entire product lifecycle including collection, recycling, and disposal. Applies to sales documents and requires material composition tracking.

features.name: Carbon pricing table
features.description: New table and page for setting up carbon prices by country, including starting date, ending date, unit of measure, price per unit, and threshold values for CBAM reporting.
caveats: Must be configured per country for accurate tracking
Requires threshold setup to avoid reporting small amounts

features.name: EPR materials table
features.description: New table listing all materials required to be tracked under EPR regulations. Contains material name, unit of measure, EPR fee, and verification date.

features.name: Item material composition page
features.description: New page similar to bill of materials for configuring EPR material composition. Allows specification of EPR materials, weights per unit of measure, and associated fees for items subject to EPR.
caveats: Requires EPR category to be set on item
Status must be changed from new to certified
Optional calculation fee and sorting fee fields available

features.name: Excise taxes framework for CBAM and EPR
features.description: New framework for calculating and tracking sustainability compliance taxes. Provides foundation for CBAM and EPR calculations with specialized batch types and calculation logic.
caveats: Requires separate batch setup for CBM and EPR
Manual batch creation needed for each type

features.name: Sustainability fast tab on item card
features.description: New tab on item card containing sustainability-related fields including sustainability account, carbon emissions, EPR category, material composition, end of life disposal information, and emission verification status.
caveats: Minimum requirement is to have carbon emissions set for CBAM items
End of life disposal information is not mandatory but recommended for reporting

features.name: Excise transaction logs for CBAM and EPR
features.description: Journal and transaction log system for recording and reviewing all CBAM and EPR calculations. Tracks source type, compliance status, emissions data, and enables export for reporting purposes.

features.name: Emission verification and CBAM compliance flags
features.description: Item-level configuration options to mark whether carbon emissions are verified and whether an item is CBAM-compliant. Only CBAM-compliant items are used in CBAM calculations.
caveats: Verification status is important for audit trail
